Rainfall generator parameters

Source: R/synthetic_rain.R
rain_parameters.Rd

The built-in parameters of each rainfall generator, one row per calendar month. They are illustrative, chosen to resemble lowland England (about 760 mm a year, frontal winters and convective summers), and are not fitted to any site. Use fit_rain() for parameters that resemble a real gauge.

Usage

rain_parameters(method = c("nsrp", "bartlett_lewis", "markov_gamma"))

Arguments

method

One of nsrp, bartlett_lewis or markov_gamma.

Value

A data frame with month and the method's columns, classed pdm_rain_parameters.

Details

The Neyman-Scott values were set by hand. The Bartlett-Lewis values were fitted to the Neyman-Scott model's own statistics, and the Markov chain and gamma values to 200 years of its daily rain, so all three describe the same climate.

  • nsrp: lambda storms per hour; beta rate of the exponential delay from a storm's origin to each cell, per hour; nu mean cells per storm (Poisson); eta rate of the exponential cell duration, per hour; mux mean cell intensity, mm/h (exponential).

  • bartlett_lewis: lambda storms per hour; gamma rate at which a storm stops producing cells, per hour; beta cell arrival rate while it does, per hour; eta and mux as above. A cell starts at the storm's origin.

  • markov_gamma: p01 chance a day is wet after a dry day; p11 after a wet day; shape and scale of the gamma wet-day amount, mm.

See also

synthetic_rain(), fit_rain()

Examples

rain_parameters("nsrp")
#>    month    lambda       beta       nu       eta       mux
#> 1      1 0.0180000 0.08000000 4.000000 0.6000000 0.8000000
#> 2      2 0.0174641 0.09473721 3.933013 0.6602886 0.9607695
#> 3      3 0.0160000 0.13500000 3.750000 0.8250000 1.4000000
#> 4      4 0.0140000 0.19000000 3.500000 1.0500000 2.0000000
#> 5      5 0.0120000 0.24500000 3.250000 1.2750000 2.6000000
#> 6      6 0.0105359 0.28526279 3.066987 1.4397114 3.0392305
#> 7      7 0.0100000 0.30000000 3.000000 1.5000000 3.2000000
#> 8      8 0.0105359 0.28526279 3.066987 1.4397114 3.0392305
#> 9      9 0.0120000 0.24500000 3.250000 1.2750000 2.6000000
#> 10    10 0.0140000 0.19000000 3.500000 1.0500000 2.0000000
#> 11    11 0.0160000 0.13500000 3.750000 0.8250000 1.4000000
#> 12    12 0.0174641 0.09473721 3.933013 0.6602886 0.9607695
